detail.notes: two raised panels with mitred moulded surrounds; tall upper panel (about v 0.09-0.47), shorter lower panel (about v 0.60-0.92); flat stiles and rails

notes: Oblique three-quarter view from the lobby; whole leaf visible so bounds are reliable, but the leaf is a strong trapezoid (top edge +3.7 deg, bottom -9.6 deg), hence low squareness. Perspective-corrected leaf aspect is 2.22 against a bbox aspect of 2.10; use 2.22 for proportion. Door is set in a deep reveal, so the band outside the closing edge is the jamb return (0.11 of leaf width) rather than a shadow gap. Peephole reads oversized for a plain viewer (about 0.08 of leaf width) - probably a wide-angle/digital viewer. Paint reads neutral-to-slightly-cool white; the measured median is darkened by the shaded recess, the door is a plain white in reality.
